HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   B. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.
   D. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   C. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.

7. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

9. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   C. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   D. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   C. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   B. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   D. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. D — Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. B — Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Plan income and spending wisely

6. C — Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Colonialism in Contemporary Society; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
